item.title: Asking for a haircut
item.description: Explain how you want your hair cut and styled, from how much to take off to where you want your parting.

children.definition: A person who cuts mainly men's hair and may also cut or shave their beards.
children.example: I asked the barber to cut the sides shorter and leave the top a bit longer.
collocations: ask the barber for a shorter cut

children.definition: Hair cut so that it falls over the top part of your face, above your eyes.
children.example: Could you leave my fringe just above my eyebrows?

children.definition: The line where your hair is divided so that it falls to the left and right.
children.example: I'd like my parting on the left, please.
children.translation_uz: sochni ikki tomonga ajratib turadigan chiziq

children.definition: A flat tool with a row of teeth that you pull through your hair to make it neat.
children.example: Could you use a comb to move my hair to the left so I can see how it looks?
collocations: run a comb through your hair

children.definition: To make hair go round in loose or tight rings.
children.example: Could you curl my hair loosely after the cut?

children.definition: To make wavy or curly hair straight.
children.example: Could you straighten my hair after the cut? I'd like it smooth for a work dinner.

children.definition: Sections of hair cut to different lengths, with shorter hair lying over longer hair.
children.example: I'd like long layers, with the shortest pieces just below my chin.

children.definition: A small object that closes over some of your hair to hold it in place.
children.example: Could you use a hair clip to keep the top section out of the way while you cut the sides?
collocations: hold your hair back with a hair clip

children.definition: The tips of your hair, farthest from where it grows.
children.example: Please cut just the ends. I want to keep my hair long.

children.definition: The way your hair looks as a whole because of how it is cut and arranged.
children.example: I'd like a hairstyle I can get ready in five minutes before work.

children.definition: A cutting tool with two sharp blades that you open and close with your fingers.
children.example: Could you use scissors around my ears so you can take off just a little?

children.definition: A tool, usually electric, used to cut hair, especially for short haircuts.
children.example: Could you use clippers on the sides and leave the top long enough to comb?

children.definition: How long your hair is from where it grows to its tips.
children.example: I'd like to keep the length at the back so I can still tie my hair up.

children.definition: A place where people can have their hair cut, coloured or styled.
children.example: At the salon, I showed a photo of the cut I wanted before they started.
collocations: get a haircut at a salon
